label.zh: 360天后，至少3个国家投了赞成：赞成国成为成员
label.en: After 360 days with at least 3 countries voting aye: aye countries become members

bridges.evidence: galcom.2 sets galcom_form_aye / _nay (events/galactic_community_events.txt:86-120); hidden galcom.3 360 days later: if 3+ playable countries have aye, aye countries join and get galcom.5, nay countries get galcom.6 (galactic_community_events.txt:134-175)

label.zh: 同上：投反对者收到“拒绝社群”窗口
label.en: Same: those who voted nay get the rejection window

label.zh: 成立后20天，向尚未表态的国家发出邀请
label.en: Twenty days after founding, an invitation to countries that have not voted

bridges.evidence: galcom.3 schedules galcom.15 after 20 days which fires galcom.16 (galactic_community_events.txt:165-170, 288, 317); galcom.14 (decade pulse, 00_on_actions.txt:299) and action.110 fire 16 for later non-members

label.zh: 不足3票：提案搁置，50年后重试（galcom.20）
label.en: Fewer than 3 aye: shelved, retried 50 years later (galcom.20)

bridges.evidence: galcom.3 else branch: sets galcom_form_failed, fires galcom.10 and schedules galcom.20 after 18000 days, which restarts galcom.2 if conditions hold (galactic_community_events.txt:176-191, 458-520)

label.zh: 首个银河议会成立时（on_galactic_council_established → 隐藏50，5天后）
label.en: When the first Galactic Council is established (on_galactic_council_established -> hidden 50, 5 days later)

bridges.evidence: 00_on_actions.txt:4400 -> galcom.50, trigger no first_council_formed flag; fires galcom.51 after 5 days (galactic_community_events.txt:522-608)

note.zh: 赞成者 5、反对者 6，票数不足则所有表态者得 10。
note.en: Aye voters get 5, nay voters 6; with too few votes all who voted get 10.

notes.zh: 入口：每年脉冲隐藏事件 galcom.1：未成立、未开始建立；至少3个非灭绝国家，且有国家与70%以上可玩国家通信；随后向相互通信的非灭绝国家发出 galcom.2，并在360天后运行 galcom.3 点票。
notes.en: Entry: yearly hidden galcom.1: not founded and not begun; at least 3 non-homicidal countries and one with communications to 70%+ of playable countries; then galcom.2 goes to all communicating non-homicidal countries and galcom.3 tallies 360 days later.

scope.zh: 银河社群的诞生：提议、投票、成立或搁置，以及银河议会的组建。
scope.en: Birth of the Galactic Community: proposal, vote, founding or shelving, and the formation of the Galactic Council.
